description: This file defines a custom exception class `ProvisioningEntryAlreadyCreatedException` which extends a general exception `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException`. It is used to signal that a provisioning entry for a specific date and identifier already exists in the system.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryAlreadyCreatedException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating that a provisioning entry for a given ID and date has already been created.

methods.name: ProvisioningEntryAlreadyCreatedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific message, details, and identifier.
